$description: The one icon set: Phosphor, regular weight, with the fill weight where a glyph must read as solid the bold weight for the plus, which reads thin in the regular, and the bold dots for More (Phosphor Icons, MIT License). Each glyph names its Phosphor icon and weight (regular, fill or bold), and none is drawn by hand: a unit test fails when a path differs from the @phosphor-icons/core SVG for its name and weight. scripts/buildGlyphs.ts compiles the paths into the page registry (apps/web/src/lib/icons.ts) and the player registries (apps/web/src/player/ui/iconPaths.tsx for what loads with every page, iconPathsLazy.tsx for everything), so the two can never drift. Phosphor has no numbered skip glyphs: replay10 and forward30 are plain circular arrows and the control sets its own numeral. Paths are rebuilt from the package with `npm run glyphs -- --fetch` and committed here; a build never touches the network.
